description.zh: 三种食物和四种可在分拣台回收的杂物，使用独立的 Kenney 模型和图标，出现在厨房和杂物掉落中。
description.en: Three foods and four recyclable junk items with their own Kenney models and icons, found in kitchen and junk loot.

disable.zh: 关闭后再读档，本包物品会消失，食物效果会失效。原来的食物记录可能还会占一个食物槽，到时间后消失。
disable.en: Loading a save with this package disabled removes its items and food bonuses. An old food record may still occupy a food slot until its timer expires.

uninstall.zh: 卸载后再读档，本包物品会消失，食物效果会失效。原来的食物记录可能还会占一个食物槽，到时间后消失。
uninstall.en: Loading a save after uninstalling this package removes its items and food bonuses. An old food record may still occupy a food slot until its timer expires.
